findings.finding: The compiler does not list either Concord Broadcast Exchange binding source in report.designSources and does not load or validate the coordinate schedule.
findings.requiredFix: Load the schedule, abort on coordinate/count drift, and include both binding files in designSources.

findings.finding: The compiler uses a generic terraced venue through x680..730 while the binding main shell ends at x715 and reserves x716..730 for service, tower, and garden interfaces.
findings.requiredFix: Replace the generic venue with the exact five-object site schedule and prove zero cross-object collision except reviewed interfaces.

findings.finding: Compiler underground floor plates are y29 and y42 inside [682,28,-421,728,55,-354]. Binding floors are B2 y41, B1 y53, G0 y65, G1 y74, and roof y83.
findings.requiredFix: Use the frozen datums and exact room envelopes. Repeat dry, gravity, and block-entity census on the final target cells.

findings.finding: The compiler models twelve repeated above-ground colored masses and four underground masses, not the schedule's individually bounded rooms and exact program counts. Several current room boxes are solid rather than enterable shells.
findings.requiredFix: Generate every scheduled object ID, preserve corridors and acoustic vestibules, and prove each exactCounts value from surviving final-state room identities.

findings.finding: The compiler has one generic cabaret mass and no independently counted 84-position Hall A or 42-position Hall B with stages, screens/backdrops, aisles, and open-bay analogues.
findings.requiredFix: Implement both exact halls and machine-check seat/open-bay counts, stage-before-seating orientation, sightline aisles, backstage routes, and two independent egress directions.

findings.finding: The compiler's alleged garden is at y30, x701..726 and is labeled open_to_sky_b1_smoking_garden. The binding garden is x717..730, y53..64, z-380..-352, roofless, smoke/fire-free, with 24 seats and two vestibules.
findings.requiredFix: Use the exact garden reservation, remove the smoking-room role, prove open sky and two-vestibule separation, and count exactly 24 seats.

findings.finding: The compiler reports two stair cores and one lift. The binding requires north/south public stair-lift-refuge cores, north/south service/performer stair-lift cores, and a central freight lift, all serving B2/B1/G0/G1/roof.
findings.requiredFix: Implement all five scheduled cores and pass no-jump, four-block-clear, level-landing, route-separation, and bidirectional egress QA.

findings.finding: The compiler tower is centered near (660,-338), rises only about 46 blocks from a derived court elevation, and has no four counted maintenance decks. Binding tower bounds are [717,64,-425,730,145,-411].
findings.requiredFix: Move the tower to its reserved envelope, add exactly four maintenance decks and locked service access, then prove separation from public routes and the protected beehive.

findings.finding: The compiler pad is x610..640, z-345..-331 with three same-size dish masses. Binding pad is [737,62,-425,769,78,-390] with exactly one large, four medium, and four small dishes and no target below y62 over protected buried water.

findings.finding: The generic Concord backstage/service route is drawn after the buildings at a fixed courtY and can erase north facade cells without named loading doors or thresholds.
findings.requiredFix: Reserve doors and loading thresholds first, use the exact east service lane, and reject all other road/building cross-scope overrides.

findings.finding: The binding has 18 object-linked cameras. The compiler exposes only four broad Concord cameras and publishes only Gilded Raven object records globally.
findings.requiredFix: Emit all scheduled CBE object records and 18 first/second-pass camera pairs into the database import and exact-object media manifest before publication.
